CREATE PROCEDURE [CFG].[HIST_STG_Orders] AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @StartDate datetime = GETDATE()
	DECLARE	
		@StartDateStr varchar(30) = CONVERT(varchar(30), @StartDate, 121),
		@CloseDate datetime = DATEADD(ms, -2, @StartDate),
		@Inserted int = 0, 
		@Deleted int = 0, 
		@Updated int = 0
	
	EXEC [LOG].[PACKAGE_RUN_LOG_ENTRY] 
		@PackageName = 'HIST_STG_Orders', 
		@TableName = '[STG].[Orders]', 
		@StartTimeStr = @StartDateStr, 
		@Inserted = NULL, 
		@Updated = NULL, 
		@Deleted = NULL

	IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [IMP].[Orders] GROUP BY [OrderID] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('Table [IMP].[Orders] contains duplicated data and cannot be historized', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Orders] WHERE [DAT_VON_HIST] >= @StartDate)
		DELETE FROM [STG].[Orders] WHERE [DAT_VON_HIST] >= @StartDate

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Orders] WHERE @StartDate BETWEEN [DAT_VON_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] <> '99991231')
		UPDATE [STG].[Orders]
			SET [DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231'
		WHERE 
			@StartDate BETWEEN [DAT_VON_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] AND [DAT_BIS_HIST] <> '99991231'

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [STG].[Orders] WHERE [DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [STG].[Orders](
			[CustomerID],
			[EmployeeID],
			[Freight],
			[OrderDate],
			[OrderID],
			[RequiredDate],
			[ShipAddress],
			[ShipCity],
			[ShipCountry],
			[ShipName],
			[ShippedDate],
			[ShipPostalCode],
			[ShipRegion],
			[ShipVia],
			[DAT_VON_HIST],
			[DAT_BIS_HIST])
		SELECT 
			I.[CustomerID],
			I.[EmployeeID],
			I.[Freight],
			I.[OrderDate],
			I.[OrderID],
			I.[RequiredDate],
			I.[ShipAddress],
			I.[ShipCity],
			I.[ShipCountry],
			I.[ShipName],
			I.[ShippedDate],
			I.[ShipPostalCode],
			I.[ShipRegion],
			I.[ShipVia], 
			@StartDate, 
			'99991231'
		FROM 
			[IMP].[Orders] I

		SET @Inserted = @Inserted + @@ROWCOUNT

		GOTO FINISH
	END

	CREATE TABLE #T 
	(
		[CustomerID] nchar(5),
		[EmployeeID] int,
		[Freight] money,
		[OrderDate] datetime,
		[OrderID] int,
		[RequiredDate] datetime,
		[ShipAddress] nvarchar(60),
		[ShipCity] nvarchar(15),
		[ShipCountry] nvarchar(15),
		[ShipName] nvarchar(40),
		[ShippedDate] datetime,
		[ShipPostalCode] nvarchar(10),
		[ShipRegion] nvarchar(15),
		[ShipVia] int,
		[SATZ_ID] bigint, 
		[DAT_VON_HIST] datetime,
		HIST_SCD_TYPE int,
		[DAT_BIS_HIST_PREV] datetime
	)

	INSERT INTO #T([CustomerID],
		[EmployeeID],
		[Freight],
		[OrderDate],
		[OrderID],
		[RequiredDate],
		[ShipAddress],
		[ShipCity],
		[ShipCountry],
		[ShipName],
		[ShippedDate],
		[ShipPostalCode],
		[ShipRegion],
		[ShipVia], 
		[SATZ_ID], 
		[DAT_VON_HIST], 
		HIST_SCD_TYPE, 
		[DAT_BIS_HIST_PREV])
	SELECT
		I.[CustomerID],
		I.[EmployeeID],
		I.[Freight],
		I.[OrderDate],
		I.[OrderID],
		I.[RequiredDate],
		I.[ShipAddress],
		I.[ShipCity],
		I.[ShipCountry],
		I.[ShipName],
		I.[ShippedDate],
		I.[ShipPostalCode],
		I.[ShipRegion],
		I.[ShipVia], 
		S.[SATZ_ID],
		S.[DAT_VON_HIST],
		2 HIST_SCD_TYPE,
		NULL
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			[CustomerID],
			[EmployeeID],
			[Freight],
			[OrderDate],
			[OrderID],
			[RequiredDate],
			[ShipAddress],
			[ShipCity],
			[ShipCountry],
			[ShipName],
			[ShippedDate],
			[ShipPostalCode],
			[ShipRegion],
			[ShipVia]
		FROM
			[IMP].[Orders] I
		EXCEPT SELECT 
			[CustomerID],
			[EmployeeID],
			[Freight],
			[OrderDate],
			[OrderID],
			[RequiredDate],
			[ShipAddress],
			[ShipCity],
			[ShipCountry],
			[ShipName],
			[ShippedDate],
			[ShipPostalCode],
			[ShipRegion],
			[ShipVia]
		FROM
			[STG].[Orders] S (NOLOCK)
		WHERE 
			[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231'
	) I
	LEFT JOIN [STG].[Orders] S (NOLOCK) ON
		S.[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231' AND
		(S.[OrderID] = I.[OrderID])

	UPDATE H
	SET [DAT_BIS_HIST] = @CloseDate
	FROM
		#T T
		INNER JOIN [STG].[Orders] H ON
			H.[SATZ_ID] = T.[SATZ_ID]
	WHERE
		T.[SATZ_ID] IS NOT NULL AND
		T.HIST_SCD_TYPE = 2 AND
		T.[DAT_VON_HIST] < @StartDate

	SET @Updated = @Updated + @@ROWCOUNT

	INSERT INTO [STG].[Orders]([CustomerID],
		[EmployeeID],
		[Freight],
		[OrderDate],
		[OrderID],
		[RequiredDate],
		[ShipAddress],
		[ShipCity],
		[ShipCountry],
		[ShipName],
		[ShippedDate],
		[ShipPostalCode],
		[ShipRegion],
		[ShipVia], [DAT_VON_HIST], [DAT_BIS_HIST])
	SELECT 
		[CustomerID],
		[EmployeeID],
		[Freight],
		[OrderDate],
		[OrderID],
		[RequiredDate],
		[ShipAddress],
		[ShipCity],
		[ShipCountry],
		[ShipName],
		[ShippedDate],
		[ShipPostalCode],
		[ShipRegion],
		[ShipVia], @StartDate, '99991231'
	FROM 
		#T T
	WHERE
		([SATZ_ID] IS NULL OR HIST_SCD_TYPE = 2)

	SET @Inserted = @Inserted + @@ROWCOUNT

	UPDATE S
	SET 
		[DAT_BIS_HIST] = @CloseDate
	FROM
		[STG].[Orders] S
	WHERE
		[DAT_BIS_HIST] = '99991231' AND
		[DAT_VON_HIST] < @StartDate AND
		NOT EXISTS 
		(
		SELECT 1 FROM
			[IMP].[Orders] I (NOLOCK)
		WHERE
			(S.[OrderID] = I.[OrderID])
		)

	SET @Deleted = @Deleted + @@ROWCOUNT
FINISH:

	UPDATE STATISTICS [STG].[Orders]

	EXEC [LOG].[PACKAGE_RUN_LOG_ENTRY] 
		@PackageName = 'HIST_STG_Orders', 
		@TableName = '[STG].[Orders]', 
		@StartTimeStr = @StartDateStr, 
		@Inserted = @Inserted, 
		@Updated = @Updated, 
		@Deleted = @Deleted
END
